hypothesis: A complete-context high-reasoning review with source-bound API contracts, local codec abstention, and continuation after rejection can recover valid controlled failures hidden by the old fixed first-alert replay.
cohort: All 17 development trials; same full source ranking, round-robin schedule and stop rule.

policy.stop: First semantic_supported candidate per trial. Never substitute after evaluator rejection.

inputs: Original controlled-failure pool and source-only edited-contract-call-priority-v1 ranking. No truth labels or hidden/reference code in model payload.
freshness: Fresh model review; candidate construction and native failures remain historical. This is not fresh end-to-end synthesis.
novelty: Pipeline restoration and evidence integration; no algorithmic novelty claim from this round alone.
isolation: Dispatch from a frozen detached worktree so ongoing implementation does not alter sealed imported source.
diagnostic_findings: N01 wrongly copies an open-response assertion to an in-memory response that is already closed.
P2 uses an uppercase shifted primary codepoint forbidden by the public Kitty grammar. Passing original controls do not establish the input domain.
N03 strengthens a batch-size upper bound into an exact count after duplicating a watch path. The actual count is 1 and the maximum is 2; no upper-bound violation is observed.
N10 is independently valid, but the decisive public default-put document was absent from the provider request. P7 required an additional public transform definition for independent review.
The source pool includes historical trajectory tests. Fresh model review is not new source-only synthesis.
decision: Preserve the entire fixed nine-alert component for uniform comparison. Do not suppress or replace N01, P2 or N03 after audit. Evaluate any new contract/domain guard as a separate frozen method.
evidence_limits: The queue fixes one candidate per supported trial and stops at the global call budget. It does not exhaust its 1438-candidate inventory.
Independent review is by a separate agent, not an independent human panel.
Unknown and invalid complete tests are both excluded from verified true counts.
The six verified trials substantially overlap the existing best component; component results cannot be summed.
